items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: He wasn't into it until he came into my band... I called Bill, an emergency... They really (inaudible) some records with me.

ctx.x: Well, after his ex-pause out there (inaudible) the kind of Blue record was really cause expose it to Bill, was the fact that Bill could do that very well, and was into all the modes and all that business of the scales.

(Inaudible) He wasn't into it until he came into my band. Just my band, Bill was a great reader and has full of knowledge is a great man with harmony. I remember the first record, the piano player didn't show up,

so I called Bill, an emergency, and he was asking all about it. I said, 'Well, you can play any kind of passing fancy chords you want, long as it has a pedal on this chord here.' (inaudible). That was for Bethlehem Records. It was (singing), Hello, Mom. I don't remember the names of them, but there was talking on the record. You remember that one?
